changes: Scoped reversal of the rejected native-art task restores earlier scenic browser/cards/details/results/invitation/track picker. The unused ChallengeGraphic class and its UID are removed. Five restored UI modules match their exact pre-diagram source text. Prior Find & play and creation separation is preserved.

Five versioned v2 original edits keep the earlier subjects and composition with calmer light, dry asphalt, simpler surfaces, regular barriers, coherent car/wheel/window geometry and no visible lettering/manufacturer badges. Original v1 assets/provenance remain.

Garage cards depict three separate unbranched closed loops. Foreground clutter is simplified to three cards, one single-hand stopwatch, one pencil and folded checkered cloth. A second targeted edit removes the parked car rear badge/tiny lettering.

The duel has two cars; the group grid six; the series artwork three separate closed circuits, three cars and three lights per circuit. Series poster fitting reserves the caption space and displays the full image so all three circuits/starts remain visible. Other format posters keep their existing fill/crop presentation with a slightly clearer inactive tint.

The existing distinct-rendered-artwork test is retained, changing only its obsolete native-diagram wording. Flow, exact timing, verification, attempts, car selection and account invariants are unchanged.

provenance.originals: Five project-owned v1 PNGs, inspected locally before editing. No external copied reference pixels.

execution.renderers: Windows RTX 3090 OpenGL Compatibility and Vulkan Forward Mobile. Mobile is the desktop renderer, not a phone test.

corrections: Initial garage edit retained a circular rear car badge and tiny hatch lettering. A second targeted image_gen edit removes those; initial output and exact cleanup prompt are retained in refinement-v2.json.

First native format captures cropped top and bottom series detail. Initial-crop-formats retains these views. The final series card fits the full image above the caption; final Compatibility/Mobile checks each pass270 and final screenshots show all three circuits and start bars.

The first Mobile cards run loaded the pre-crop source. It is retained as cards-mobile.log; cards-mobile-final.log and a final native capture verify the final framing. No assertions were removed or weakened.

detail_review: Blue car has coherent rear/near-side wheel geometry and lights, two consistent chevrons and one checkered flag.
Three closed route-card loops, one central-hand stopwatch, pencil and regular folded checkered cloth. Garage car rear badge/lettering removed.
Two rival cars, six group cars, three closed circuits and nine start lights counted in the source artwork.
All three series circuits/starts remain visible in the final normal and compact native cards.
visual_review.limits: Illustrated promotional art, not an exact render of the selected playable car or track. Fixture UI captures use deterministic test values; the race browser uses actual selected route data in production.

checkpoint.scope: Task-only source, import, provenance and documentation delta against pre-task snapshots. The five new binary PNGs are stored in the workspace and fingerprinted in new_assets, without duplicating their bytes in a text review patch. Unrelated working tree and generated build identity changes excluded. No staging or commit.

limitations_and_remaining_acceptance: Client reload is needed in an already running game.
Owner aesthetic acceptance and physical-device readability/touch acceptance remain. Generated illustrations are not claimed to be universally artifact-free or AAA certified.
No phone/tablet attachment check, physical-device test, APK/export/install, account/backend mutation, system/social sharing, purchase or deployment by this task.
